2d-ify.name: 2D-ify
2d-ify.description: Allows the user to trap others inside paintings. Using a picture frame, the user can absorb people and objects, turning them into 2D paintings that are contained within frames.

absorption-and-release.name: Absorption and Release
absorption-and-release.description: Absorbs energy-based emitter attacks that strike the user, stores them briefly, and releases the same force back toward the attacker. Works against directed energy assaults; physical strikes are not absorbed.

accelerator-rings.name: Accelerator Rings
accelerator-rings.description: Allows the user to generate yellow rings of energy from their hands and feet. After a variable delay, the rings release a burst of force in a single direction before dissipating.

acid.name: Acid
acid.description: Allows the user to create corrosive liquid from their skin, with it being naturally resistant to the acid they produce.

acid-sweat.name: Acid Sweat
acid-sweat.description: Allows the user to secrete an acidic sweat with combustive and explosive properties from their palms.

air-cannon.name: Air Cannon
air-cannon.description: Releases compressed air blasts that generate directional impact.

air-walk.name: Air Walk
air-walk.description: Lets the user stand on and steer pockets of air, achieving levitation and midair repositioning. Improves mobility for evasion and ranged attacks by freeing the user from ground contact.

air-wall.name: Air Wall
air-wall.description: Lets the user create circular shields made of compressed air from their hands in order to shield themselves.

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.description: Transmutes the matter of any non-living object the user touches into different materials or finished items. The user can produce simple projectiles or complex constructs such as fully operational drones, limited by available source matter.

all-for-one.name: All For One
all-for-one.description: Allows the user to steal other quirks for personal use or transfer stolen quirks to another person. The user can wield multiple stolen quirks at the same time, stacking their effects.

amplivolt.name: Amplivolt
amplivolt.description: Allows its user to conduct and enhance electricity within their body before releasing it afterwards. Once amplified enough, the user is able to fire blasts of stored electricity from their hands.

anivoice.name: Anivoice
anivoice.description: Lets the user speak with and command animals. The mutation also produces a rock-like head and horns that extend vocal commands over longer distances.

anthropomorph.name: Anthropomorph
anthropomorph.description: Allows the user to take a human-sized object (a refrigerator, a desk, etc.) and turn it into an exact lookalike of any given person.

antigen-swap.name: Antigen Swap
antigen-swap.description: Allows the user to change their blood type at will.

arbor.name: Arbor
arbor.description: Generates and controls wooden tendrils from any part of the body. The wood can sprout, extend over long distances, and be shaped for restraint, defense, or structural support.

assault-dust.name: Assault Dust
assault-dust.description: Generates and manipulates dust, firing it at high speed as dense particulate attacks.

attraction-of-small-objects.name: Attraction of Small Objects
attraction-of-small-objects.description: Exerts a telekinesis-like pull that draws small objects toward the user. The maximum mass or size limit is unclear, but lightweight metal items and similarly small objects can be yanked from a distance.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.description: Creates a telekinetic dome barrier around the user. The field can be raised quickly and used to block attacks or slow fast-moving targets that strike it.

bat.name: Bat
bat.description: Grants bat-like traits including arm wings, fangs, pointed ears, high-speed running, and flight.

beams-from-his-eyes.name: Beams From His Eyes
beams-from-his-eyes.description: Fires concentrated laser beams from the eyes when a visor switch is activated. The user must engage the switch to release a blast at whatever they are looking at.

beast.name: Beast
beast.description: Transforms the user into a large, feral beast with oversized fangs, heavy fur, and greatly increased size. In this form the user gains raw strength and animalistic fighting traits.

big-fist.name: Big Fist
big-fist.description: Enlarges one or both hands to enormous size almost instantly. The expanded limbs greatly increase striking mass and reach in melee combat.

big-horn.name: Big Horn
big-horn.description: Grants a pair of bull-like horns on the head. The horns can be detached and used to transmit signals or as sturdy striking tools.

big-monkey.name: Big Monkey
big-monkey.description: Under external enhancement, the user can transform into a giant ape-like form with immense size and strength. Its ordinary effect without amplification has not been clearly shown.

binging-ball.name: Binging Ball
binging-ball.description: Allows the user to release small floating spheres with mouths from their body. These spheres can be used as projectiles, moving at very high speeds.

black.name: Black
black.description: Allows the user to merge their body into anything that is dark-colored, whether naturally dark, or dark via external circumstances, such as shadows. They can also move themself through the darkness freely.

black-hole.name: Black Hole
black-hole.description: Allows the user to create small black holes through their fingers. The black holes suck in and disintegrate any matter at the atomic level, as well as certain forms of energy, such as light.

blackwhip.name: Blackwhip
blackwhip.description: Produces dark energy tendrils that can capture, swing, and pull targets.

blade-tooth.name: Blade-Tooth
blade-tooth.description: Grants the user the ability to enlarge and reshape their teeth into sharpened incisors. These razors can vary in both size and shape. The user can manipulate the length and direction of the teeth at will.

blast.name: Blast
blast.description: Fires rapid, continuous blasts of energy from the limbs. The user can channel the output through hands and legs, and specialized gear can help focus the discharges for aimed strikes.

blazing-hair.name: Blazing Hair
blazing-hair.description: Controls flames growing from the user\

bloodcurdle.name: Bloodcurdle
bloodcurdle.description: Temporarily paralyzes opponents after the user ingests their blood sample. Also extends the tongue with papillae used to deliver the effect.

blueflame.name: Blueflame
blueflame.description: Produces blue flames from the body at will, with a hotter burn than typical fire-based emitters.

body-bulk.name: Body Bulk
body-bulk.description: Lets the user enlarge their entire body, greatly increasing physical strength and overall mass.

body-morph.name: Body Morph
body-morph.description: Adds a second pair of arms and grants greatly enhanced physical strength.

bombify.name: Bombify
bombify.description: Mutates parts of the body to grow explosive charges of varying size. The quirk behaves like an artificial augmentation tied to implanted bomber cells within the user.

boomerang.name: Boomerang
boomerang.description: Curves the trajectory of thrown objects so they home in on targets. Affected objects and the user\

brainwashing.name: Brainwashing
brainwashing.description: Forces compliant responses from a target after vocal interaction.

brown-bear.name: Brown Bear
brown-bear.description: Grants bear-like strength, durability, senses, and large sharp claws.

bruiser.name: Bruiser
bruiser.description: Charges one limb with stored force; longer charging yields a stronger strike.

bubble.name: Bubble
bubble.description: Allows the user to make bubbles, of various sizes, filled with an aroma that they have smelled at least once before.

bull-head.name: Bull Head
bull-head.description: Gives the user a pair of bull-like horns on their head.

bullet-laser.name: Bullet Laser
bullet-laser.description: Allows the user to fire purple-colored lasers from their fingertips, which they can fire both as direct blasts, as well as curve said beams straight from their fingers.

bullhorn.name: Bullhorn
bullhorn.description: It appears to allow the user\

burst.name: Burst
burst.description: Makes the user explode in a blinding flash of light. Appears to be a one-time, self-destructive activation.

cell-activation.name: Cell Activation
cell-activation.description: Allows its user to activate the cells in their body or another person\

cemedine.name: Cemedine
cemedine.description: Allows the user to spray a glue-like liquid from the holes in their head. Once it hits something, the glue will either harden up and trap whatever it makes contact with or make it sticky and dangerous to touch.

cement.name: Cement
cement.description: Gives the user the ability to manipulate cement-based material simply by being in contact with the surface. It does not give them the ability to create new cement, they can only reshape existing cement.

centipede.name: Centipede
centipede.description: Extends long centipede-like limbs from the arms, legs, and head for ranged grabs and restraint.

chameleon.name: Chameleon
chameleon.description: Grants chameleon-like traits including wall climbing, independently rotating eyes, and camouflage coloring. The user can blend into surroundings and strike from concealed positions.

charging-muscles.name: Charging Muscles
charging-muscles.description: Allows the user to charge up strength in their muscles, enhancing the strength of an attack into a powerful blow.

chart.name: Chart
chart.description: Creates a holographic tracking display that locates and monitors targets. The user can observe a tracked subject\

chest-hair.name: Chest Hair
chest-hair.description: Presumably enhances masculine physique traits based on its name; full capabilities are poorly documented.

chimera.name: Chimera
chimera.description: Combines traits from multiple animals, enhancing them and allowing monstrous enlargement of any chosen feature.

chronostasis.name: Chronostasis
chronostasis.description: Grants arrow-shaped hair that extends in straight lines to cut targets and slow them on contact. A forward hair cluster acts as the primary striking point above the forehead.

clean-bubbler.name: Clean Bubbler
clean-bubbler.description: Allows the user to create and control soapy water from their body. The stream is strong enough to keep several people in the air.

cleaning.name: Cleaning
cleaning.description: Secretes a soap-like substance that weakens or nullifies other quirks when scrubbed onto targets.

clones.name: Clones
clones.description: Creates clones of the user from a glowing viscous fluid released from the mouth. Dozens of copies can exist at once, though they typically dissipate after taking damage or after a short time.

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.description: Allows the user to create different-sized clouds, of varying densities, enough to be touched and even to hold up the weight of one or several people.

comic.name: Comic
comic.description: Allows the user to materialize onomatopoeia into the real world in the form of giant Japanese letters by speaking them. The onomatopoeia is manifested with the same effects as the sound they\

compress.name: Compress
compress.description: Shrinks anything inside a touched spherical zone into a small marble without damage. Requires hand contact to activate.

confession.name: Confession
confession.description: After the user asks a question, the target is compelled to answer truthfully. The effect reveals thoughts, secrets, and intentions the victim would otherwise conceal.

conjure.name: Conjure
conjure.description: Allows the user to target any relatively small object and warp it straight into their hand.

control-glass.name: Control Glass
control-glass.description: Controls and reshapes large amounts of glass in the surrounding area. The user can shift glass between solid and liquid states and form blades or barriers from it.

control-horn.name: Control Horn
control-horn.description: Lets the user mind-control cattle within range. Hundreds of animals can be directed at once for stampedes or coordinated movement.

copy.name: Copy
copy.description: Lets the user temporarily wield another person\

cow.name: Cow
cow.description: Allows the user to alter their body with the characteristics of a cow. This includes hooves, horns, and the skin of a cow. This increases the user\

creation.name: Creation
creation.description: Converts body resources into non-living matter with known composition.

crystallize.name: Crystallize
crystallize.description: Allows the user to grow a large number of crystals from their body, completely covering their skin with them. The crystals are shown to be both durable and able to grow near-instantaneously.

cubism.name: Cubism
cubism.description: Allows the user to transform others into 3D versions of Cubism artwork.

curse.name: Curse
curse.description: Turns the entire body into paper talismans, making the user extremely light. Paper strips can be launched as sharp strands.

danger-sense.name: Danger Sense
danger-sense.description: Allows the user to detect any potential threats in the surrounding area, thus giving the user the opportunity to properly react to them quickly, essentially granting them a sixth sense.

dark-ball.name: Dark Ball
dark-ball.description: Releases clusters of black spheres outlined in purple that emit destructive dark energy. The orbs can be launched as ranged attacks and combined with other emitter effects.

dark-shadow.name: Dark Shadow
dark-shadow.description: Manifests an autonomous shadow-like entity with offensive and defensive utility.

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.description: Manifests a misty dark purple fluid from the fingers and soles that spreads across terrain. Anything coated by the fluid breaks down and collapses into decayed matter.

day-dream.name: Day Dream
day-dream.description: Allows the user to make any person they look at fall unconscious, or be put into a controllable, hypnotic state for a short period of time.

decay.name: Decay
decay.description: Disintegrates touched matter through a rapid chain-like breakdown effect.

delay-spot.name: Delay Spot
delay-spot.description: Creates a semi-spherical bubble that slows everything inside to a crawl, including people and projectiles. Bullets lose most of their speed while trapped in the field.

despot.name: Despot
despot.description: Extrudes control threads that puppeteer other people\

dog.name: Dog
dog.description: Greatly enhances hearing and smell. The user can detect distant sounds and estimate how many people are present in a large area such as a forest.

double.name: Double
double.description: Creates up to two duplicates of anything touched, including people and objects. The copies can fight or assist until dismissed or destroyed.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.description: Allows the user to transform into a dragon, a powerful mythological creature. This form grants them abilities commonly associated with dragons, including flight, powerful jaws and claws.

dragon-breath.name: Dragon Breath
dragon-breath.description: Expels fire from the mouth for ranged attacks. Fueling the flames requires consuming alcohol shortly before use.

dupli-arms.name: Dupli-Arms
dupli-arms.description: Grants the user a set of arm-like tentacles adjacent to their arms that can transform into duplicates of their other body parts.

dust.name: Dust
dust.description: Produces ash-like dust from the body. The cloud can blind and irritate foes when thrown at the eyes, nose, and mouth.

eagle.name: Eagle
eagle.description: Grants an eagle-like body plan and presumably avian senses and mobility. The full combat capabilities of the transformation have not been fully documented.

earphone-jack.name: Earphone Jack
earphone-jack.description: Extends long, controllable earlobes that function like audio cables. The tips can plug into objects or surfaces to transmit sound, vibration, or shock.

earth-flow.name: Earth Flow
earth-flow.description: Manipulates nearby earth and stone, molding it into walls, pillars, or other shapes. Large-scale constructs can be raised quickly for offense, defense, or terrain control.

eel.name: Eel
eel.description: Lets the user transform into a medium-sized eel suited to aquatic movement. When amplified externally, the form can swell into a huge eel-like body with extremely slick skin.

elasticity.name: Elasticity
elasticity.description: Makes any touched object rubbery and elastic. The user can stretch, bounce, and redirect items for traps, mobility, or improvised weapons.

electric-charge.name: Electric Charge
electric-charge.description: Collects and manipulates ambient electrical current. Stored electricity can be discharged in attacks or used to jam nearby electronic signals.

electric-eel.name: Electric Eel
electric-eel.description: An evolved form of an eel-type transformation that adds powerful electrical discharge to the aquatic body. The user can attack with high-voltage shocks while in the altered shape.

electricity-generation.name: Electricity Generation
electricity-generation.description: Produces and manipulates electricity, firing it as aimed lightning bolts rather than only through direct contact. Unlike simple contact shocks, the user can strike distant targets with concentrated arcs.

electrification.name: Electrification
electrification.description: Generates and discharges electrical energy to shock nearby targets.

electromagnetic-bullets.name: Electromagnetic Bullets
electromagnetic-bullets.description: Generates an electromagnetic field that boosts the force and impact of thrown objects. Any projectile launched while the field is active hits with amplified power.

endurance.name: Endurance
endurance.description: Gives the user the ability to convert their mobility and morale into physical energy, granting them a significant increase in stamina and endurance, effectively transforming them into "a stamina beast".

energy-suck.name: Energy Suck
energy-suck.description: By making physical contact and then inhaling, the user can absorb the vitality of others, not only giving themselves more stamina, but also gaining an increase in size and strength.

enfeeble.name: Enfeeble
enfeeble.description: Allows the user to stare into someone\

engine.name: Engine
engine.description: Provides propulsion through biological engine structures in the legs.

eraser.name: Erasure
eraser.description: Suppresses target quirk activation while visual contact is maintained.

erasure-spot.name: Erasure Spot
erasure-spot.description: Creates a dome-shaped energy wave that deactivates the quirks of everyone inside its range.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.description: Allows the user to burn their fat to produce a lava-like substance, that\

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.description: Allows the user to excrete nitroglycerin-like sweat from their palms and ignite it at will to create explosions of various sizes.

extend-o-hair.name: Extend-o-Hair
extend-o-hair.description: Controls the length, shape, and movement of all body hair. The hair is extremely tough and effectively indestructible, allowing binding, defense, and striking uses.

extra-arms.name: Extra Arms
extra-arms.description: Gives the user an extra set of arms.

fa-jin.name: Fa Jin
fa-jin.description: Builds kinetic energy through repetitive movement, visible as red glowing power that can be stored and released in bursts.

fan.name: Fan
fan.description: Allows the user to create wind or even tornadoes by spinning their wrists.

fast-fist.name: Fast Fist
fast-fist.description: Allows the user to move at least their hands extremely quickly, letting them hit up to 100 times in less than a second.

fat-absorption.name: Fat Absorption
fat-absorption.description: Grants the user the ability to adhere any objects to their body and make them sink into their body fat upon contact with it.

fiber-master.name: Fiber Master
fiber-master.description: Manipulates textile fibers for binding, shaping, and movement control.

fierce-wings.name: Fierce Wings
fierce-wings.description: Controls detached feathers individually for flight, attack, and rescue tasks.

fire-cracker.name: Fire Cracker
fire-cracker.description: Lets the user tear off portions of their hair and detonate them like firecrackers. The bursts are strong enough to damage structures and stagger nearby targets.

flash-bang-sweat.name: Flash Bang Sweat
flash-bang-sweat.description: Secretes a sweat that flashes brightly and produces a loud detonation on impact. The substance can fill projectiles or gear to create ranged flash-bang effects.

flight.name: Flight
flight.description: Grants high-speed flight and levitation. An aerodynamic barrier can extend over anything in contact with the user, shielding passengers from heat, cold, and physical hazards.

float.name: Float
float.description: Lets the user levitate and hover in midair. When combined with a large stockpile of borrowed power, the effect becomes true high-speed flight rather than simple hovering.

fly-swatter.name: Fly Swatter
fly-swatter.description: Projects concussive energy waves beyond normal arm reach. The user typically swings an arm at high speed to launch the wave toward a distant target.

flying-squirrel.name: Flying Squirrel
flying-squirrel.description: Glides through the air using wing-like membranes on the arms. The user can carry roughly one additional person\

foldabody.name: Foldabody
foldabody.description: Folds and unfolds body sections to alter shape and avoid damage.

food.name: Food
food.description: Allows the user to bite, chew, and digest virtually any material they can touch. Hard or hazardous objects can be consumed with little resistance from the material itself.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.description: Allows the user to accurately predict all of a target\

free-walker.name: Free Walker
free-walker.description: The exact limits are undocumented, but the quirk appears to let the user move their legs continuously without fatigue. It primarily enhances sustained running or marching endurance.

frog.name: Frog
frog.description: Grants amphibian traits including wall adhesion, leaping, and tongue extension.

frost.name: Frost
frost.description: Allows the user to manipulate and produce ice around their body, coating themselves in ice and blasting it outward.

gale-gale.name: Gale Gale
gale-gale.description: Manipulates wind and wraps it around the body for flight and offense. Concentrated gusts around the user can repel attacks and throw targets off balance despite a harmless appearance.

gas.name: Gas
gas.description: Generates poisonous, sleep-inducing gas from the body. The user can release enough purple fog to blanket a large outdoor area.

gatling.name: Gatling
gatling.description: Forms gun-like organs in the arms that fire keratin claw projectiles. The shots are suited for rapid, close-to-mid-range offense.

gearshift.name: Gearshift
gearshift.description: Allows the user to change the speed at which things accelerate through space. It is even capable of changing speeds while ignoring the laws of inertia.

gecko.name: Gecko
gecko.description: Grants a reptilian body and powerful wall-clinging adhesion. The user can stay attached to sheer surfaces and moving vehicles without slipping.

gigantic-spinning-flying-turtle.name: Gigantic Spinning Flying Turtle
gigantic-spinning-flying-turtle.description: Appears to grant turtle-like flight and spinning movement, though its full limits are unclear. It may force exaggerated size or constant rotation when active.

glamour.name: Glamour
glamour.description: Creates short-lived visual and auditory illusions. The user releases a mist from the mouth that shapes into false scenery, voices, or disguises.

glide-and-slide.name: Glide and Slide
glide-and-slide.description: Lets the user skate rapidly along solid surfaces by emitting repulsive force from the palms and soles. Several limb contact points are needed to stay balanced; pushing gestures similar to roller skating build speed.

glycerin.name: Glycerin
glycerin.description: Secretes a smooth, moisturizing liquid through the skin. The effect keeps skin supple and can maintain a youthful appearance regardless of age.

good-ear.name: Good Ear
good-ear.description: Extends hearing into ultrasonic ranges beyond normal human perception. The user can pick up distant signals, covert transmissions, and approximate how many people are nearby from sound alone.

grasshopper.name: Grasshopper
grasshopper.description: Allows the user the ability to transform into a large humanoid grasshopper, increasing their physical capabilities.

gyrate.name: Gyrate
gyrate.description: Spins any body part at extreme speed, turning limbs into drill-like weapons. The rotation greatly boosts piercing power in close combat.

hair-raiser.name: Hair-Raiser
hair-raiser.description: Extends and hardens strands of the user\

half-cold-half-hot.name: Half-Cold Half-Hot
half-cold-half-hot.description: Allows the user to generate ice, frost, and cold from the right side of their body, and fire, flames, and heat from the left.

hardening.name: Hardening
hardening.description: Temporarily increases body hardness to improve durability and striking power.

hardflame-fan.name: Hardflame Fan
hardflame-fan.description: Generates layered walls of fire for defense over parts of the body. The flames can also manifest as a viscous, glowing green liquid in some uses.

heal.name: Heal
heal.description: Allows the user to amplify and quicken their target\

heavy-payload.name: Heavy Payload
heavy-payload.description: Seemingly increases the damage output of the user\

helical-scythe.name: Helical Scythe
helical-scythe.description: Grants the user large, red appendages on their fingers and head, which they are able to extend and manipulate like tendrils.

hellflame.name: Hellflame
hellflame.description: Generates and controls high-temperature flames for offense and propulsion.

high-specs.name: High Specs
high-specs.description: Grants the user unparalleled intelligence, perception, reactions and comprehension that far surpasses that of any human.

hologram.name: Hologram
hologram.description: Projects holographic images of anything the user imagines, including enormous constructs visible from far away. The illusions are visual only unless paired with other effects.

homing.name: Homing
homing.description: Allows the user to lock on to any target that they can see within six hundred meters of themselves and make any projectile they release chase after said target.

horn-cannon.name: Horn Cannon
horn-cannon.description: Detaches and launches the horns as regenerating projectiles. Multiple horns can be fired in succession before a new set regrows on the head.

hula-hoop.name: Hula Hoop
hula-hoop.description: After raising their arm, the user can generate a large hoop of energy that they can throw at their opponent to attack them.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.description: Allows the user to summon gigantic, serpentine shark-like creatures from their back that they can control at will. The creatures are large enough to crush a person in their jaws.

hypertrophy.name: Hypertrophy
hypertrophy.description: Enlarges parts of the body, most commonly an arm, to massive proportions on demand. The growth sharply increases reach and striking mass for melee attacks.

ice-ply.name: Ice Ply
ice-ply.description: Allows the user to freely manipulate any and all nearby ice. They can freely gather, move, attack with, and defend with the ice they control.

ignition.name: Ignition
ignition.description: Produces fire abilities with a small flame maintained on top of the head. The user can exhale powerful flares from the mouth for ranged attacks.

impact-recoil.name: Impact Recoil
impact-recoil.description: Allows the user to reverse the impact caused by an opposing physical force, damaging the opposition instead.

impure-beam.name: Impure Beam
impure-beam.description: Fires a wide, destructive beam of light capable of leveling large areas in a single shot. One of the most devastating long-range emitter attacks when fully charged.

infrared.name: Infrared
infrared.description: Grants infrared perception that maps heat across the surroundings. The user can sense people, machines, and environmental changes without normal line of sight.

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.description: Causes the user to unconsciously refract the light that hits them, granting them a completely invisible body.

iq.name: IQ
iq.description: Allows the user to enhance their intellect by multiplying their IQ, and become a super-genius temporarily after consuming tea and closing their eyes to think.

iron-ball.name: Iron Ball
iron-ball.description: Produces and launches iron spheres from the knuckles. The user can vary each ball\

iron-claws.name: Iron Claws
iron-claws.description: Turns the fingertips into metal claws suited for digging and tearing. The claws can burrow through soil and rip through tough materials in close combat.

iron-club.name: Iron Club
iron-club.description: Transforms the arms into spiked iron clubs. The clubs can crush stone and deliver heavy blunt force blows.

jet.name: Jet
jet.description: Grants the user the ability to expel air from open holes on the soles of their feet. This allows them to fly around a limited range as well as move faster than the eye can follow, even on the ground.

kaiju.name: Kaiju
kaiju.description: Its ordinary effect is poorly documented, but under external amplification the user becomes a colossal dinosaur-like creature with immense destructive power.

kinetic-booster.name: Kinetic Booster
kinetic-booster.description: Increases the kinetic energy the user generates and releases in movement and strikes. Stacking multiple copies of the quirk multiplies the boost further.

king-slam.name: King Slam
king-slam.description: Materializes a large hammer from nowhere and swings or throws it at targets. The weapon appears fully formed and ready to strike without preparation.

landmine.name: Landmine
landmine.description: Bestows explosive properties on anything the user touches. Detonations can be triggered at will after the charge is set.

larceny.name: Larceny
larceny.description: Instantly pulls any possessed object from a target into the user\

laser.name: Laser
laser.description: Allows the user to fire energy beams from their right eye.

leafipulation.name: Leafipulation
leafipulation.description: Allows its user to manipulate leaves from the plant life around them, and fire them off as projectiles toward the user\

leap.name: Leap
leap.description: Propels the user in enormous jumps across great height and distance. It is not true flight; the user still needs a surface to launch from.

lion.name: Lion
lion.description: Grants lion-like strength, speed, and reflexes. The user can unleash a powerful roar that disrupts certain sound-based attacks.

liquification.name: Liquification
liquification.description: Allows the user to liquefy their body.

lizard.name: Lizard
lizard.description: Grants the user a reptilian appearance, with a tail, a tongue with two tines, and a body covered in scales.

lizard-tail-splitter.name: Lizard Tail Splitter
lizard-tail-splitter.description: Splits the body into telekinetically controlled pieces. Detached segments can move independently for scouting, restraint, or multi-angle attacks.

lock-down.name: Lock Down
lock-down.description: Anchors anything touched to a fixed point in space, effectively freezing it in place. Activated through contact points on the user\

longbow.name: Longbow
longbow.description: Transforms the thumb and pinky of one hand into a bow that can launch virtually any small object with precise aim. Ammunition can be improvised from nearby items.

longleg.name: Longleg
longleg.description: Allows the user to extend their legs.

love.name: Love
love.description: Allows the user to power up a target by confessing their feelings for them. The more intense the user\

luminescence.name: Luminescence
luminescence.description: Emits bright light from the body, even from infancy. The output typically grows stronger as the user matures.

mad-gluttony.name: Mad Gluttony
mad-gluttony.description: Allows the user to devour objects using the giant mouth in their stomach, with it being able to quickly inhale, crunch, and destroy whatever is in their path.

magic.name: Magic
magic.description: Creates energy rings from the wrist that can capture and move people or objects. While a target remains inside a ring, the user can change its orbital speed at will.

magnetism.name: Magnetism
magnetism.description: Magnetizes people within about 4.5 meters of the user. The effect can target the whole body or specific limbs and torso sections.

manifest.name: Manifest
manifest.description: Temporarily manifests biological traits from consumed material sources.

mantis.name: Mantis
mantis.description: Grants mantis-like limbs and combat traits, including bladed forearms and agile striking. Under amplification the form becomes larger and more monstrous.

meatball.name: Meatball
meatball.description: Grants the user the ability to manipulate raw human flesh. The user can manipulate their own flesh, giving them the ability to separate their limbs and control them at will.

metal-manipulation.name: Metal Manipulation
metal-manipulation.description: Controls existing metal the user touches, reshaping it into barriers, weapons, or entangling structures. The effect applies to metal already present in the environment.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.description: Allows the user to transfer their own body and mind into solid objects, and manipulate them as though the object was their actual body.

mind-reading.name: Mind Reading
mind-reading.description: Receives active thought information from a target under specific conditions.

mind-reaper.name: Mind Reaper
mind-reaper.description: On touch, forces the target to blurt out secrets, shameful memories, or thoughts they want hidden. The revelations continue until the contact ends or the victim collapses.

mole.name: Mole
mole.description: Allows the user to grow long, sharp claws from their fingers, spines on their back, and a shield visor on their face, to help them dig through the Earth, just like a mole.

monster-cat.name: Monster Cat
monster-cat.description: Allows the user to merge with an object or machinery, assume its shape, and control it completely. It can also be defused from said object.

monster-summon.name: Monster Summon
monster-summon.description: Creates multiple monsters resembling dungeon-game enemies, usually blob-shaped bodies with large mouths and varied designs. The summons can attack independently under the user\

muddied.name: Muddied
muddied.description: Grants the user the ability to cause minor amnesia to a person if they make contact with their head, making their memories of the previous five minutes and the next five minutes vague.

multiplier.name: Multiplier
multiplier.description: Grows additional arms from the torso, multiplying close-range striking options. Each limb can act independently in combat.

mummification.name: Mummification
mummification.description: Controls the red bandages wrapped around the user to ensnare objects and wrap them into humanoid mummy puppets. The created mummies can be commanded to fight or move.

muscle-augmentation.name: Muscle Augmentation
muscle-augmentation.description: Amplifies and reshapes muscle tissue inside or outside the body for immense strength, speed, and durability. The user can bulk up selectively for offense or defense.

muscle-expansion.name: Muscle Expansion
muscle-expansion.description: Allows the user to expand and strengthen their muscles, granting them a significant increase in physical strength.

mushroom.name: Mushroom
mushroom.description: Allows the user to generate and spread fungus spores from their body. Once these spores make contact with a solid surface, they will quickly grow into full-grown mushrooms.

mutant-bovini.name: Mutant Bovini
mutant-bovini.description: Allows its user to fire off lasers from their face.

navel-laser.name: Navel Laser
navel-laser.description: Fires bright laser beams from the navel. The rays are precise, flashy, and suited for sustained ranged offense.

new-order.name: New Order
new-order.description: Allows the user to set a rule onto their surroundings after touching the target and calling out their name, allowing them to manipulate and bestow new properties onto themselves and the world around them.

octopus.name: Octopus
octopus.description: Provides the user with the physiology and skills of an octopus, such as multiple elastic appendages, suckers and the ability to spit ink from their siphon-like mouth.

octopus-squid.name: Octopus (Squid)
octopus-squid.description: Gives the user the same number of limbs as a cephalopod creature, making them appear like a humanoid octopus or squid.

one-for-all.name: One For All
one-for-all.description: Stockpiles power across generations and can be passed to a chosen successor. Grants overwhelming strength, speed, and energy output, but full mastery demands long training and bodily adaptation.

outburst.name: Outburst
outburst.description: Forces people nearby into intense, uncontrollable laughter that leaves them helpless. The effect spreads to anyone within range who hears the induced laughter.

overclock.name: Overclock
overclock.description: Accelerates the user to supersonic speed where the world appears frozen. Perception and reaction keep pace with the movement, enabling rapid strikes and rescues.

overhaul.name: Overhaul
overhaul.description: Disassembles and reassembles matter touched with bare hands at a near-molecular level. The user can destroy targets, restore them, or reconfigure them into new shapes and weapons.

pain-blocker.name: Pain Blocker
pain-blocker.description: Prevents the user from feeling internal or external pain. Combined with high endurance, this allows continued fighting despite severe injury.

permeation.name: Permeation
permeation.description: Allows body matter to phase through solid objects while active.

physical-enhancement.name: Physical Enhancement
physical-enhancement.description: Raises overall physical ability when activated, often shown as a green flame-like aura around the body. Strength, speed, and toughness increase for a limited time.

plant.name: Plant
plant.description: Allows the user to transform their body parts into plant structures. These structures have properties which can heal their allies.

playtime.name: Playtime
playtime.description: Its normal function is unclear, but under external amplification the user swells to gigantic size while gaining toy-like or distorted body traits similar to gigantification.

pointer.name: Pointer
pointer.description: After spinning in place, the user\

poison-gas.name: Poison Gas
poison-gas.description: Generates a toxic fog that sickens anyone who breathes it. If not vented regularly, the gas builds up inside the user\

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
poltergeist.description: Telekinetically moves nearby objects and people without direct contact. Large groups of debris can be lifted and hurled as barrages.

polygraph.name: Polygraph
polygraph.description: Allows the user to judge the authenticity and genuineness of their target\

pop-off.name: Pop Off
pop-off.description: Produces detachable adhesive spheres that stick strongly to contacted surfaces.

power.name: Power
power.description: Grants its user the ability to build up tremendous raw power in their body, giving them incredible strength that\

power-stock.name: Power Stock
power-stock.description: Allows the user to stockpile power, which they can harness for incredible bursts of strength and speed.

propagation.name: Propagation
propagation.description: Duplicates and grows extra body parts across the user\

quad-arms.name: Quad Arms
quad-arms.description: Adds a second pair of functional arms. The extra limbs improve multitasking, grappling, and hand-to-hand combinations.

queen-beam.name: Queen Beam
queen-beam.description: Allows the user to fire a straight-travelling beam of energy from their face. When used, a pink heart appears over the user\

queen-bee.name: Queen Bee
queen-bee.description: Centers on a parasitic bee that can invade a host through the eye socket and take control of the body. The swollen abdomen houses the controlling organism.

rabbit.name: Rabbit
rabbit.description: Enhances leg strength, agility, and sensory responsiveness with lagomorph traits.

radio-waves.name: Radio Waves
radio-waves.description: Allows the user to emit an electromagnetic pulse of radio waves to disrupt electrical appliances and cause communicators to malfunction.

radio-waves-bombers.name: Radio Waves (Bombers)
radio-waves-bombers.description: Emits electromagnetic pulses strong enough to disrupt electronics and communications across an area. Power grids and radio gear fail while the pulse persists.

razor-sharp.name: Razor Sharp
razor-sharp.description: Produces large blades from anywhere on the body. Blade shape, size, and angle can be varied for slashing or piercing attacks.

reflect-flect-turn.name: Reflect (Flect Turn)
reflect-flect-turn.description: Allows the user to absorb energy and send it back in the opposite direction. When something strikes them, a spiraling wave of energy forms from behind, and the same attack is rebound back at the opponent.

reflect-tomura-shigaraki.name: Reflect (Tomura Shigaraki)
reflect-tomura-shigaraki.description: Allows the user to copy any attack they are hit with and recreate the same attack themselves at the same strength. They can absorb multiple sources at the same time, but it releases in one direction all at once.

rewind.name: Rewind
rewind.description: Reverses a living target to a previous biological state over time.

rifle.name: Rifle
rifle.description: Extends a functional rifle barrel from the right elbow cavity. The user folds the arm to open the port and fire ballistic shots with normal gun mechanics.

rivet.name: Rivet
rivet.description: Generates rivet-like metal growths from the arms that can be launched or used in melee. The exact size and number of rivets can vary between users.

rivet-stab.name: Rivet Stab
rivet-stab.description: Produces black tendrils with red fractured lines from the fingers and other body surfaces. The tendrils pierce, bind, and whip targets at range or in melee.

rocket-thrust.name: Rocket Thrust
rocket-thrust.description: Allows the users to shoot their right fists at people at very high speeds.

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.description: Allows the user to detonate their own body.

saber.name: Saber
saber.description: Allows the user to transform portions of their body into sword-shaped appendages, which they can use offensively.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.description: Transforms the upper body into manipulable sand. The user can reshape the sand mass into weapons, shields, or flowing attacks.

scalemail.name: Scalemail
scalemail.description: Covers the body with sharp armored scales that boost strength and defense. The scales are typically dark red and act as both armor and cutting surfaces.

scales.name: Scales
scales.description: Allows the user to form hard scales throughout their entire body, which they can either use as protective armor, or fire them off as projectiles.

scanning.name: Scanning
scanning.description: Detects and identifies nearby quirks to a limited degree and estimates power level through heat-signature-like vision.

scatter.name: Scatter
scatter.description: Allows the user to split up and multiply projectiles while firing them, increasing the strength and radius of long-range attacks.

search.name: Search
search.description: Allows the user to monitor and observe up to a hundred people at a time. This includes knowing their locations and weak points.

self-detonation.name: Self-Detonation
self-detonation.description: Grants the user the ability to self-destruct through a large explosion that is generated within their bodies.

serpentress.name: Serpentress
serpentress.description: Grants the user a trio of living snakes as part of their hair, which are implied to be a part of their biology.

shame.name: Shame
shame.description: Grows stronger as the user becomes more embarrassed, converting humiliation into physical power. Deliberate exposure or ridicule can spike output dramatically.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: Allows the user to manifest stone-like, hexagonal shields from their body that can be utilized both defensively and offensively.

shock-absorption.name: Shock Absorption
shock-absorption.description: Dampens the force of physical impacts that hit the user, canceling or weakening many blunt attacks. Does not stop cutting or piercing unless paired with other defenses.

shoulder-mounted-jets.name: Shoulder-Mounted Jets
shoulder-mounted-jets.description: Deploys four retractable jet boosters on the upper back for burst flight and rapid repositioning. The thrusters fold away when not in use.

size.name: Size
size.description: Changes the size of objects the user touches, shrinking or enlarging them. Activation requires pressing all five fingertips against the target at once.

slide-and-glide.name: Slide and Glide
slide-and-glide.description: Allows the user to project an repulsive/attractive force from their hands and feet. Repulsive energy emits a blue glow , while attractive energy emits a green glow.

sloshed.name: Sloshed
sloshed.description: Causes anyone who approaches the user to lose their sense of balance, falling into a state similar to inebriation.

smile.name: Smile
smile.description: Forces victims who see the user\

smoke.name: Smoke
smoke.description: Allows the user to expel large amounts of pink smoke through the holes in their body, to generate a thick smoke screen to mask and hide their movement from enemies\

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.description: Allows the user to generate a thick cloud of purple smoke from their body. The smoke can be spread to cover a very wide area.

snip-clip.name: Snip Clip
snip-clip.description: Allows the user to cut through almost anything that is placed between their index and middle fingers by making a scissor motion with them.

soccer.name: Soccer
soccer.description: Supposedly allows the user to dribble a ball like a professional soccer player among large crowds of people without this preventing them from carrying out their acts of larceny.

softening.name: Softening
softening.description: Allows the user to soften anything they touch, effectively turning solid objects semi-liquid. Softening works on anything solid, such as ice, metal, or the ground, and it possesses great range.

solid-air.name: Solid Air
solid-air.description: Solidifies exhaled air into platforms, walls, or barriers that float in place. Constructs can support the user and allies without collapsing downward.

somnambulist.name: Somnambulist
somnambulist.description: Releases a sleep-inducing aroma from the skin that knocks targets unconscious. The effect is stronger against males than females.

soul.name: Soul
soul.description: Manifests a small pink bird-like companion linked to the user\

spatial-excursion.name: Spatial Excursion
spatial-excursion.description: Allows the user to freely move objects and people in any space without being restricted by gravity.

spear-hand-missiles.name: Spear Hand Missiles
spear-hand-missiles.description: Fires the small reloadable missile segments that form the user\

spearlike-bones.name: Spearlike Bones
spearlike-bones.description: Allows the user to generate cone-shaped spears made of bone on any part of their body. They can also emerge from other parts of the body such as the mouth.

spike.name: Spike
spike.description: Allows its user to make spikes protrude from their body. The spikes produced naturally appear to be roughly as long as its user\

spotted-seal.name: Spotted Seal
spotted-seal.description: Combines spotted-seal traits with enhanced strength and agility on land and in water. The user can perform seal-like swimming and powerful physical strikes.

spray-art.name: Spray Art
spray-art.description: Allows the user to spray clouds of spray paint, causing illusions for anyone inside them.

spring.name: Spring
spring.description: Makes anything the user touches extremely bouncy. Objects and surfaces rebound with exaggerated elasticity until the effect ends.

squirmy-fingers.name: Squirmy Fingers
squirmy-fingers.description: Allows the user to precisely and flawlessly control their fingers, effectively manipulating any object with grace, ease, speed, precision and skill, as well as to bend them in any direction.

static.name: Static
static.description: By rubbing their body to build up electric charge, like the process used to generate static electricity, the user can generate electrical currents.

steel.name: Steel
steel.description: Turns the entire body into steel for extreme durability. The metal skin resists bullets, blades, and heavy impacts, though weight increases.

stiffening.name: Stiffening
stiffening.description: Hardens any object kneaded between both hands, up to concrete-like rigidity. Rubber or soft materials can become tough barriers or weapons.

stock.name: Stock
stock.description: Absorbs incoming attacks and stores their energy for later release. Absorbed power appears as a growing mass on the user\

storage.name: Storage
storage.description: Stores objects and even living beings inside the user\

stress.name: Stress
stress.description: Grants the user the ability to convert stress, anger, dread, and frustration into raw power. This raw power is capable of increasing their strength, resilience, and size.

strongarm.name: Strongarm
strongarm.description: Allows the user to rotate and move their shoulders at great speed and power, giving them extremely fast and strong punches.

sugar-rush.name: Sugar Rush
sugar-rush.description: Temporarily boosts physical output after metabolizing sugar intake.

suicide-bomb.name: Suicide Bomb
suicide-bomb.description: Little is documented beyond its name, but it appears to trigger massive explosions centered on the user that devastate the surrounding area.

super-regeneration.name: Super Regeneration
super-regeneration.description: Allows the user to regenerate virtually any injury on their body, such as missing limbs, at incredible speeds.

swan.name: Swan
swan.description: Grants the user two large, white, swan-like wings on their back. They can achieve flight but are not strong enough to do so without them stripping off their clothes first.

sword-kill.name: Sword Kill
sword-kill.description: Allows the user to create flexible swords from their arms and shoulders, that fold in and out like an accordion.

tail.name: Tail
tail.description: Grants a long, prehensile tail from the lower back. The appendage is bulky and can grab, balance, or strike like an extra limb.

tank-engine.name: Tank Engine
tank-engine.description: Transforms the head and upper torso into the front of a steam locomotive, including functional smokestack and train mass. The user moves with the momentum of a rail engine.

tape.name: Tape
tape.description: Ejects adhesive tape from elbows for restraint, traversal, and object handling.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.description: Moves inanimate objects through telekinesis. When amplified by a compatible booster quirk, the number of objects controlled at once rises sharply.

telepath.name: Telepath
telepath.description: Grants telepathic communication and instruction through thought. The user can send clear messages to one or multiple people at once.

teleportation.name: Teleportation
teleportation.description: Allows the user to move themselves and any material or living thing they are touching to somewhere within their line of vision and are limited to only transporting to an area they can see.

telescopic.name: Telescopic
telescopic.description: Allows the user to retract their own body parts into themselves, similar to how a turtle can retract itself into its shell.

tidal-bore.name: Tidal Bore
tidal-bore.description: Expels large volumes of water from the mouth for torrent attacks or lifting heavy objects. The stream can be shaped into pressurized blasts.

toho.name: Toho
toho.description: Gives the user the attributes of a kaiju; in addition to their reptile-like appearance, they are very large and very strong.

tongue-tank.name: Tongue Tank
tongue-tank.description: Transforms the tongue into an extendable tank cannon that fires rock-like shells when the mouth opens. The barrel stretches outward for ranged bombardment.

tool-arms.name: Tool Arms
tool-arms.description: Manifests limbs embedded with tools and weapons such as chainsaws, hammers, and drills. Each arm can carry a different built-in implement.

traject.name: Traject
traject.description: Allows the user to manipulate the trajectory of anything that passes through their bandages.

transforming-arms.name: Transforming Arms
transforming-arms.description: Allows its user to shape-shift their arms, allowing them to have long-ranged, elastic attacks. The user can also split their arms apart to surround their target and launch multiple attacks at once.

trap-flex.name: Trap Flex
trap-flex.description: Allows the user to flex their trapezius muscle to extreme degrees, allowing them to cover their whole head with their shoulders. The flexing gives them a fair amount of speed and strength.

tree-frog.name: Tree Frog
tree-frog.description: Extends the tongue outward with limited extra reach compared to stronger tongue quirks. The tongue curls back when not in use and supports basic capture or probing.

tripod.name: Tripod
tripod.description: Grants its user a third leg, placed between their other two. This third leg acts as one would expect, including allowing the user to stabilize themselves on otherwise unstable terrain.

twin-impact.name: Twin Impact
twin-impact.description: Allows the user to, at the site of any initial impact, create a second impact remotely and at their discretion. The second impact will be many times stronger than the initial one.

vibrate.name: Vibrate
vibrate.description: Generates vibrations and shockwaves that travel through solids, liquids, and air. The user can shake objects they touch with their hands to destabilize structures or opponents.

vibration-detection.name: Vibration Detection
vibration-detection.description: Senses subtle vibrations in the environment similar to echolocation. The user can map nearby movement and obstacles without relying on sight.

vines.name: Vines
vines.description: Grants the user controllable, thorny vines in place of regular hair. The vines can be manipulated for various purposes, such as binding foes, snatching objects and creating defensive barriers.

viral-cosmos.name: Viral Cosmos
viral-cosmos.description: Launches bursts of petals generated from flowers on the head as cutting projectiles. The petals swarm toward enemies and slice on contact.

voice.name: Voice
voice.description: Allows the user to increase the volume of their voice, giving them the ability to create loud, high-pitched sounds.

voyance.name: Voyance
voyance.description: Sees through solid objects within line of sight, excluding living organisms. The user narrows vision through a finger-frame aperture to focus the effect.

warp-gate.name: Warp Gate
warp-gate.description: Creates dark fog portals that teleport anything touched to another nearby point. Multiple gates can link different locations in quick succession.

warping.name: Warping
warping.description: Produces black ooze from a victim\

water-control.name: Water Control
water-control.description: Manipulates existing water into claws, waves, or pressurized jets. The user can reshape large bodies of water for offense and mobility.

water-gun.name: Water Gun
water-gun.description: Allows the user to shoot a stream of water from their hands.

water-pump.name: Water Pump
water-pump.description: Generates water from hose-like spigots in place of the hands. The streams can be shaped into barriers, blasts, or sustained floods with fine control.

wave-motion.name: Wave Motion
wave-motion.description: Grants the user the ability to convert their vitality into energy that they can discharge as blast waves.

weather-manipulation.name: Weather Manipulation
weather-manipulation.description: Controls weather on a large scale, summoning storm clouds, lightning, typhoons, and other atmospheric phenomena. Entire islands can be engulfed by generated storms.

weld.name: Weld
weld.description: Fuses organic and inorganic matter together at a subatomic level on touch. Two contacted objects become physically joined into one structure.

whale.name: Whale
whale.description: Transforms part or all of the body into a sperm-whale form with immense mass. In full whale shape the user can expel powerful water jets from the mouth.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.description: Controls surrounding air with minimal body movement, creating gales, updrafts, and precise wind blades. The user can fly and repel projectiles using pressure alone.

whiteline.name: Whiteline
whiteline.description: Animates painted road lane lines into tendrils for binding, lifting, or throwing objects. Any nearby marked pavement becomes an extension of the user\

whole-body-lens.name: Whole-Body Lens
whole-body-lens.description: Allows the user to produce camera-like lenses anywhere on their body to take pictures. They can also print any pictures their body cameras have captured out of their chest whenever they want.

wing.name: Wing
wing.description: Sprouts large black wings that enable free flight at very high speed. Maneuverability in the air is strong, though stamina limits are not fully known.

wooden-swords-from-his-hands.name: Wooden Swords From His Hands
wooden-swords-from-his-hands.description: Allows the user to generate wooden swords from their wrist.

zero-gravity.name: Zero Gravity
zero-gravity.description: Negates gravitational pull on touched targets until effect release or overload.

zombie-virus.name: Zombie Virus
zombie-virus.description: Allows the user to release a pinkish gas that, when inhaled, temporarily transforms victims into zombies.

zoom.name: Zoom
zoom.description: Magnifies distant vision when the user focuses on a point, clearly seeing targets several kilometers away. Works like a biological telescopic lens.

2d-ify.name: Plano 2D
2d-ify.description: Permite ao usuário prenda outras pessoas dentro de pinturas. Usando uma moldura, o usuário pode absorver pessoas e objetos, transformando-os em pinturas 2D contidas em molduras.

absorption-and-release.name: Absorção e Liberação
absorption-and-release.description: Absorve ataques de emissores baseados em energia que atingem o usuário, armazena-os brevemente e devolve a mesma força ao atacante. Funciona contra assaltos de energia direcionada; golpes físicos não são absorvidos.

accelerator-rings.name: Anéis do Acelerador
accelerator-rings.description: Permite ao usuário gere anéis amarelos de energia de suas mãos e pés. Após um atraso variável, os anéis liberam uma explosão de força em uma única direção antes de se dissipar.

acid.name: Ácido
acid.description: Permite ao usuário crie líquido corrosivo a partir de sua pele, sendo naturalmente resistente ao ácido que produz.

acid-sweat.name: Suor Ácido
acid-sweat.description: Permite ao usuário segregue um suor ácido com propriedades combustíveis e explosivas das palmas das mãos.

air-cannon.name: Canhão de Ar
air-cannon.description: Libera rajadas de ar comprimido que geram impacto direcional.

air-walk.name: Caminhada no Ar
air-walk.description: Permite ao usuário apoiar-se e dirigir bolsões de ar, alcançando levitação e reposicionamento no ar. Melhora a mobilidade para esquiva e ataques à distância ao liberar o usuário do contato com o solo.

air-wall.name: Parede de ar
air-wall.description: Permite ao usuário crie escudos circulares feitos de ar comprimido de suas mãos para se proteger.

alchemy.name: Alquimia
alchemy.description: Transmuta a matéria de qualquer objeto inanimado que o usuário toque em outros materiais ou itens prontos. O usuário pode produzir projéteis simples ou construtos complexos, como drones totalmente operacionais, limitado pela matéria disponível.

all-for-one.name: Todos por um
all-for-one.description: Permite ao usuário roubar outras individualidades para uso próprio ou transferir individualidades roubadas a outra pessoa. O usuário pode empunhar várias individualidades roubadas ao mesmo tempo, acumulando seus efeitos.

amplivolt.name: Amplivoltação
amplivolt.description: Permite que seu usuário conduza e aumente a eletricidade dentro de seu corpo antes de liberá-la depois. Uma vez amplificado o suficiente, o usuário é capaz de disparar rajadas de eletricidade armazenada de suas mãos.

anivoice.name: Voz Animal
anivoice.description: Permite ao usuário falar com animais e comandá-los. A mutação também produz cabeça semelhante a rocha e chifres que estendem comandos vocais a longas distâncias.

anthropomorph.name: Antropomorfo
anthropomorph.description: Permite ao usuário pegue um objeto de tamanho humano (uma geladeira, uma mesa, etc.) e o transforme em um sósia exato de qualquer pessoa.

antigen-swap.name: Troca de Antígeno
antigen-swap.description: Permite ao usuário altere seu tipo sanguíneo à vontade.

arbor.name: Arboreto
arbor.description: Gera e controla gavinhas de madeira a partir de qualquer parte do corpo. A madeira pode brotar, estender-se por longas distâncias e ser moldada para contenção, defesa ou suporte estrutural.

assault-dust.name: Poeira de Assalto
assault-dust.description: Permite gerar e manipular poeira, disparando-a em alta velocidade como ataques de partículas densas.

attraction-of-small-objects.name: Atração de pequenos objetos
attraction-of-small-objects.description: Exerce um puxão semelhante à telecinese que atrai pequenos objetos em direção ao usuário. O limite exato de massa ou tamanho é incerto, mas itens metálicos leves e objetos pequenos semelhantes podem ser puxados à distância.

barrier.name: Barreira
barrier.description: Cria uma barreira telecinética em forma de cúpula ao redor do usuário. O campo pode ser erguido rapidamente para bloquear ataques ou desacelerar alvos em movimento rápido.

bat.name: Rebatida
bat.description: Concede traços de morcego, incluindo asas nos braços, presas, orelhas pontudas, corrida em alta velocidade e voo.

beams-from-his-eyes.name: Raios Oculares
beams-from-his-eyes.description: Dispara feixes de laser concentrados dos olhos quando um interruptor na viseira é acionado. O usuário precisa ativar o interruptor para liberar um disparo no alvo em que está olhando.

beast.name: Fera
beast.description: Transforma o usuário em uma fera grande, com presas enormes, pelagem densa e tamanho muito aumentado. Nessa forma o usuário ganha força bruta e traços de combate animalescos.

big-fist.name: Punho Grande
big-fist.description: Amplia uma ou ambas as mãos a tamanho enorme quase instantaneamente. Os membros expandidos aumentam muito a massa de impacto e o alcance no combate corpo a corpo.

big-horn.name: Chifre Colossal
big-horn.description: Concede um par de chifres semelhantes aos de um touro na cabeça. Os chifres podem ser destacados e usados para transmitir sinais ou como ferramentas de impacto resistentes.

big-monkey.name: Macaco Gigante
big-monkey.description: Sob amplificação externa, o usuário pode se transformar em uma forma gigante semelhante a um macaco, com tamanho e força imensos. O efeito ordinário sem amplificação não foi claramente demonstrado.

binging-ball.name: Bola Devoradora
binging-ball.description: Permite ao usuário libere pequenas esferas flutuantes com bocas de seu corpo. Essas esferas podem ser usadas como projéteis, movendo-se a velocidades muito altas.

black.name: Preto
black.description: Permite ao usuário mescle seu corpo em qualquer coisa de cor escura, seja naturalmente escura ou escura por meio de circunstâncias externas, como sombras. Eles também podem se mover livremente pela escuridão.

black-hole.name: Buraco Negro
black-hole.description: Permite ao usuário crie pequenos buracos negros através de seus dedos. Os buracos negros sugam e desintegram qualquer matéria no nível atômico, bem como certas formas de energia, como a luz.

blackwhip.name: Chicote Negro
blackwhip.description: Produz tentáculos de energia escura para capturar, balançar e puxar alvos.

blade-tooth.name: Dente da Lâmina
blade-tooth.description: Concede ao usuário a capacidade de ampliar e remodelar seus dentes em incisivos afiados. Essas lâminas de barbear podem variar em tamanho e forma. O usuário pode manipular o comprimento e a direção dos dentes à vontade.

blast.name: Explosão
blast.description: Dispara explosões contínuas e rápidas de energia pelos membros. O usuário pode canalizar o efeito pelas mãos e pernas, e equipamentos especializados ajudam a focar os disparos para ataques precisos.

blazing-hair.name: Cabelo Ardente
blazing-hair.description: Controla chamas que crescem na cabeça do usuário. Pedaços de cabelo em chamas podem ser arremessados como bolas de fogo ou moldados em armas curtas semelhantes a lâminas.

blood-control.name: Controle Sanguíneo
blood-control.description: Manipula o próprio sangue do usuário depois que ele sai do corpo, controlando seu fluxo no ar. O sangue pode ser endurecido em estruturas rígidas para prender ou imobilizar alvos.

bloodcurdle.name: Coagulação
bloodcurdle.description: Paralisa temporariamente oponentes depois que o usuário ingere uma amostra do sangue deles. Também alonga a língua com papilas usadas para aplicar o efeito.

bloodlet.name: Sangue
bloodlet.description: Expulsa o sangue do usuário para fora do corpo e pode reabsorvê-lo depois. O usuário suporta perda sanguínea que normalmente seria fatal e pode moldar o sangue expelido em armas ou ferramentas.

blueflame.name: Chama Azul
blueflame.description: Produz chamas azuis a partir do corpo à vontade, com combustão mais quente que a de emissores de fogo comuns.

body-bulk.name: Corpulência
body-bulk.description: Permite ampliar todo o corpo, aumentando muito a força física e a massa geral.

body-morph.name: Morfo Corporal
body-morph.description: Acrescenta um segundo par de braços e concede força física muito aumentada.

bombify.name: Bombificação
bombify.description: Muta partes do corpo para gerar cargas explosivas de vários tamanhos. A individualidade se comporta como um aprimoramento artificial ligado a células explosivas implantadas no usuário.

boomerang.name: Bumerangue
boomerang.description: Curva a trajetória de objetos arremessados para que se dirijam aos alvos. Objetos afetados e as mãos do usuário podem brilhar em roxo quando ativa.

brainwashing.name: Lavagem Cerebral
brainwashing.description: Força respostas obedientes de um alvo após interação vocal.

brawn-boost.name: Impulso Muscular
brawn-boost.description: Aumenta temporariamente a força física do usuário. Várias cópias da mesma individualidade acumuladas em um único usuário multiplicam ainda mais o ganho de força.

bristle.name: Cerda
bristle.description: Endurece muito o cabelo do usuário para ataque ou defesa. Limites adicionais não foram claramente documentados.

brown-bear.name: Urso castanho
brown-bear.description: Concede força, resistência, sentidos e garras grandes e afiadas semelhantes aos de um urso.

bruiser.name: Brutamontes
bruiser.description: Carrega um membro com força acumulada; quanto mais longa a carga, mais forte o golpe.

bubble.name: Bolha
bubble.description: Permite ao usuário faça bolhas, de vários tamanhos, cheias de um aroma que já cheirou pelo menos uma vez antes.

bull-head.name: Cabeça de Touro
bull-head.description: Dá ao usuário um par de chifres em forma de touro em sua cabeça.

bullet-laser.name: Laser Balístico
bullet-laser.description: Permite que o usuário dispare lasers de cor roxa da ponta dos dedos, que eles podem disparar como explosões diretas, bem como curvar os referidos feixes diretamente de seus dedos.

bullhorn.name: Megafone
bullhorn.description: Não se sabe muito sobre Bullhorn, mas parece permitir que a voz do usuário fique mais alta do que o normal.

burst.name: Rompimento
burst.description: Faz o usuário explodir em um clarão ofuscante de luz. Parece ser uma ativação única e autodestrutiva.

cell-activation.name: Ativação Celular
cell-activation.description: Permite que seu usuário ative as células em seu corpo ou no corpo de outra pessoa através do toque. Isso aumenta a regeneração, o tempo de recuperação e pode até melhorar a condição física.

cemedine.name: Cemedina
cemedine.description: APrmite que o usuário pulverize um líquido semelhante a cola a partir dos orifícios em sua cabeça. Uma vez que atinge algo, a cola endurece e prende o que quer que entre em contato ou a torna pegajosa e perigosa ao toque.

cement.name: Cimento
cement.description: Dá ao usuário a capacidade de manipular material à base de cimento simplesmente por estar em contato com a superfície. Isso não lhes dá a capacidade de criar novo cimento, eles só podem remodelar o cimento existente.

centipede.name: Quilópode
centipede.description: Estende membros longos semelhantes a centopeias pelos braços, pernas e cabeça para agarrões e contenção à distância.

chameleon.name: Camaleão
chameleon.description: Concede traços de camaleão, incluindo escalada de paredes, olhos que giram de forma independente e coloração de camuflagem. O usuário pode se misturar ao ambiente e atacar de posições ocultas.

charging-muscles.name: Carregando Músculos
charging-muscles.description: Permite que o usuário carregue a força em seus músculos, aumentando a força de um ataque em um golpe poderoso.

chart.name: Painel Tático
chart.description: Cria uma interface holográfica de rastreamento que localiza e monitora alvos. O usuário pode observar a posição e os movimentos do alvo rastreado em tempo real.

chest-hair.name: Pelos no peito
chest-hair.description: Presumivelmente realça traços físicos masculinos conforme o nome; as capacidades completas são pouco documentadas.

chimera.name: Quimera
chimera.description: Combina traços de vários animais, aprimorando-os e permitindo ampliar qualquer característica escolhida a proporções monstruosas.

chronostasis.name: Cronostase
chronostasis.description: Concede pêlos em forma de flecha que se estendem em linhas retas para cortar alvos e reduzir sua velocidade ao atingir. Um aglomerado frontal de pêlos funciona como o principal ponto de ataque acima da testa.

clean-bubbler.name: Borbulhador Limpador
clean-bubbler.description: Permite que o usuário crie e controle a água com sabão de seu corpo. O riacho é forte o suficiente para manter várias pessoas no ar.

cleaning.name: Limpar
cleaning.description: Secreção de substância semelhante a sabão que enfraquece ou anula outras individualidades ao ser esfregada nos alvos.

clones.name: Clonagem
clones.description: Cria clones do usuário a partir de um fluido viscoso brilhante liberado pela boca. Dezenas de cópias podem existir ao mesmo tempo, embora em geral se dissipem ao sofrer dano ou após pouco tempo.

cloud.name: Nuvem
cloud.description: Permite que o usuário crie nuvens de tamanhos diferentes, de densidades variadas, o suficiente para serem tocadas e até mesmo para suportar o peso de uma ou várias pessoas.

comic.name: Quadrinhos
comic.description: Permite que o usuário materialize a onomatopeia no mundo real na forma de letras japonesas gigantes, falando-as. A onomatopeia se manifesta com os mesmos efeitos do som em que se baseia.

compress.name: Comprimir
compress.description: Encolhe qualquer coisa dentro de uma zona esférica tocada em um pequeno mármore sem danificar. Exige contato com a mão para ativar.

confession.name: Confissão
confession.description: Depois que o usuário faz uma pergunta, o alvo é obrigado a responder com sinceridade. O efeito revela pensamentos, segredos e intenções que a vítima tentaria esconder.

conjure.name: Conjurar
conjure.description: Permite ao usuário mire em qualquer objeto relativamente pequeno e o deforma diretamente em sua mão.

control-glass.name: Controle de Vidro
control-glass.description: Controla e remodela grandes quantidades de vidro na área ao redor. O usuário pode alternar o vidro entre estado sólido e líquido e formar lâminas ou barreiras com ele.

control-horn.name: Controle de Gado
control-horn.description: Permite controlar mentalmente gado ao alcance. Centenas de animais podem ser dirigidos de uma vez para investidas ou movimentos coordenados.

copy.name: Cópia
copy.description: Permite ao usuário usar temporariamente a individualidade de outra pessoa após tocá-la, bastando alguns fios de cabelo.

cow.name: Vaca
cow.description: Permite ao usuário altere seu corpo com as características de uma vaca. Isso inclui cascos, chifres e a pele de uma vaca. Isso aumenta a velocidade e a força do usuário em relação à de uma vaca.

creation.name: Criação
creation.description: Converte recursos do corpo em matéria inanimada de composição conhecida.

crystallize.name: Cristalização
crystallize.description: Permite que o usuário desenvolva um grande número de cristais de seu corpo, cobrindo completamente sua pele com eles. Os cristais são mostrados como sendo duráveis e capazes de crescer quase instantaneamente.

cubism.name: Cubismo
cubism.description: Permite que o usuário transforme outras pessoas em versões 3D da obra de arte cubista.

curse.name: Amaldiçoar
curse.description: Transforma todo o corpo em talismãs de papel, tornando o usuário extremamente leve. Tiras de papel podem ser lançadas como fios cortantes.

danger-sense.name: Senso de Perigo
danger-sense.description: Permite que o usuário detecte quaisquer ameaças potenciais na área circundante, dando assim ao usuário a oportunidade de reagir adequadamente a elas rapidamente, essencialmente concedendo-lhes um sexto sentido.

dark-ball.name: Bola Negra
dark-ball.description: Libera aglomerados de esferas pretas com contorno roxo que emitem energia sombria destrutiva. As esferas podem ser lançadas como ataques à distância e combinadas com outros efeitos de emissão.

dark-shadow.name: Sombra Escura
dark-shadow.description: Manifesta uma entidade sombria autônoma com utilidade ofensiva e defensiva.

darkness.name: Escuridão
darkness.description: Manifesta um fluido roxo escuro e enevoado pelos dedos e solas dos pés, que se espalha pelo terreno. Qualquer coisa coberta pelo fluido se decompõe e desmorona em matéria deteriorada.

day-dream.name: Sonho diurno
day-dream.description: Permite que o usuário faça com que qualquer pessoa que olhe caia inconsciente ou seja colocada em um estado hipnótico controlável por um curto período de tempo.

decay.name: Decadência
decay.description: Desintegra matéria tocada por meio de um efeito rápido em cadeia.

delay-spot.name: Ponto de Atraso
delay-spot.description: Cria uma bolha semiesférica que desacelera tudo em seu interior, incluindo pessoas e projéteis. Balas perdem quase toda a velocidade enquanto presas no campo.

despot.name: Déspota
despot.description: Expelir fios de controle que marionetam corpos alheios; dezenas de vítimas podem ser controladas ao mesmo tempo.

diesel-engine.name: Motor Diesel
diesel-engine.description: Transforma a cabeça do usuário e toda a parte superior do corpo na locomotiva de um trem movido a diesel e concede maior velocidade de corrida.

dog.name: Cachorro
dog.description: Amplia muito a audição e o olfato. O usuário pode detectar sons distantes e estimar quantas pessoas estão presentes numa área ampla, como uma floresta.

double.name: Duplo
double.description: Cria até duas cópias de qualquer coisa tocada, incluindo pessoas e objetos. As duplicatas podem lutar ou ajudar até serem dispensadas ou destruídas.

dragon.name: Dragão
dragon.description: Permite que o usuário se transforme em um dragão, uma poderosa criatura mitológica. Essa forma concede habilidades comumente associadas a dragões, incluindo voo, mandíbulas e garras poderosas.

dragon-breath.name: Sopro de Dragão
dragon-breath.description: Expulsa fogo pela boca para ataques à distância. Alimentar as chamas exige consumir álcool pouco antes do uso.

dupli-arms.name: Dupli-Braços
dupli-arms.description: Concede ao usuário um conjunto de tentáculos semelhantes a braços que podem se transformar em duplicatas de outras partes do corpo.

dust.name: Pó
dust.description: Produz poeira semelhante a cinzas a partir do corpo. A nuvem pode cegar e irritar inimigos quando lançada nos olhos, nariz e boca.

eagle.name: Águia
eagle.description: Concede um corpo semelhante ao de uma águia e, presumivelmente, sentidos e mobilidade aviários. As capacidades de combate completas da transformação não foram totalmente documentadas.

earphone-jack.name: Plug de Ouvido
earphone-jack.description: Estende orelhas longas e controláveis que funcionam como cabos de áudio. As pontas podem se conectar a objetos ou superfícies para transmitir som, vibração ou choque.

earth-flow.name: Fluxo da Terra
earth-flow.description: Manipula terra e pedra próximas, moldando-as em muros, pilares ou outras formas. Construtos em grande escala podem ser erguidos rapidamente para ataque, defesa ou controle do terreno.

eel.name: Enguia
eel.description: Permite ao usuário se transformar em uma enguia de tamanho médio, adequada ao movimento aquático. Sob amplificação externa, a forma pode crescer até um corpo enorme semelhante a uma enguia com pele muito escorregadia.

elasticity.name: Elasticidade
elasticity.description: Torna qualquer objeto tocado elástico e borrachudo. O usuário pode esticar, fazer quicar e redirecionar itens para armadilhas, mobilidade ou armas improvisadas.

electric-charge.name: Carga Elétrica
electric-charge.description: Coleta e manipula corrente elétrica do ambiente. A eletricidade armazenada pode ser descarregada em ataques ou usada para interferir em sinais eletrônicos próximos.

electric-eel.name: Enguia Elétrica
electric-eel.description: Uma forma evoluída de transformação tipo enguia que adiciona descargas elétricas potentes ao corpo aquático. O usuário pode atacar com choques de alta voltagem enquanto estiver na forma alterada.

electricity-generation.name: Geração de Eletricidade
electricity-generation.description: Produz e manipula eletricidade, disparando-a como raios direcionados em vez de apenas por contato. Diferente de choques por toque, o usuário pode atingir alvos distantes com arcos concentrados.

electrification.name: Eletrização
electrification.description: Gera e descarrega energia elétrica para eletrocutar alvos próximos.

electromagnetic-bullets.name: Balas Eletromagnéticas
electromagnetic-bullets.description: Gera um campo eletromagnético que aumenta a força e o impacto de objetos arremessados. Qualquer projétil lançado enquanto o campo está ativo atinge com potência amplificada.

endurance.name: Resistência
endurance.description: Dá ao usuário a capacidade de converter sua mobilidade e moral em energia física, resultando em um aumento significativo de resistência e stamina, transformando-o efetivamente em uma "besta de resistência".

energy-saver.name: Economizador de Energia
energy-saver.description: Permite que o corpo do usuário funcione com quantidades muito pequenas de nutrição e hidratação, além de possibilitar que ele processe sem precisar dormir muito.

energy-suck.name: Absorção de Energia
